footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Pan American Silver: after $2.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 40-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 28.4% to $3.6B in 2025. Operating income rose 2.3× to $1.2B, a 34.1% margin.
Net income rose 8.7× to $978M, or $2.56 per share. Operating cash flow was $1.3B and free cash flow $1.0B, versus $401M; Pan American Silver returned $221M through dividends and buybacks.
